spec.title: Home · E-paper
spec.description: The whole lab on one page for a 1600×1200 black-and-white e-paper display: Home's health judgement, then each system's numbers and its last day. Capture the whole dashboard in kiosk mode with the light theme.
What needs attention, judged by Home's own rules, worst first. While nothing does, the most recent warning or critical alert of the last week.
